title: Octopuses Have Three Hearts and Blue Blood
description: Three hearts, blue blood and arms that can taste. The octopus is stranger than you think.

scenes.text: An octopus has three hearts. Not one, not two, but three.
Two of them pump blood through the gills, where it picks up oxygen. The third pumps it around the rest of the body.
And that blood is blue. It uses copper to carry oxygen instead of iron, which is what makes ours red.
Here is the strange part. When an octopus swims, the heart that serves the body stops beating. That is one reason they prefer crawling.
Three hearts, blue blood, and it would rather walk than swim. Follow for more weird facts.
